summary.text: Democrat Tanya Miller won the November 3, 2026 election for Attorney General of Georgia, defeating Brian Strickland, according to unofficial results, and is set to take office when the new term begins.
A trial lawyer and former prosecutor, she has represented Georgia House District 62 since 2023 and is the House Democratic Caucus Chair.

paragraphs.text: Miller earned a J.D. from Case Western Reserve University and lives in Atlanta.
She worked as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in New York, as a Fulton County prosecutor handling homicides and crimes against women and children, and as a civil rights and criminal defense lawyer.
Miller was elected to the Georgia House in 2022 and took office in January 2023.
House Democrats chose her as their caucus chair in 2024.
She also serves as General Counsel to the Georgia Federation of Public Service Employees.
Tanya Miller won the November 3, 2026 general election for attorney general with 55.5% of the vote to Brian Strickland's 44.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
